findings.issue: pkill -f patterns matched the agent's own bash command line, killing its own shell (exit 143) three times, twice after it had already diagnosed the cause at turn 78
findings.suggestion: Always use pgrep to get the PID then kill by PID (as it finally did in turns 79/84/89), or exclude the current shell from the pattern
